cells.name: Frozen cryo rack
cells.description: A cryoarithmetic engine's computing cabinet, rimed over and still leaking cold light.

cells.name: Frosted heatsink bank
cells.description: Upright heat-exchanger fins on a manifold, furred with hoar frost.

cells.name: Culture vat
cells.description: An armoured bio-culture vat under a clouded, cracked dome, something pale still in the fluid.

cells.name: Overgrown grow bed
cells.description: A hydroponic trough gone wild, pale stalks and fungus spilling over its rims.

cells.name: Frost patch
cells.description: Floor decal: a thin sheet of hoar frost and cracked ice. Walkable, no cover.

cells.name: Frozen spill
cells.description: Floor decal: a frozen coolant puddle crusted with rime. Walkable, no cover.

cells.name: Biofilm patch
cells.description: Floor decal: a mat of biofilm, lichen and creeping tendrils. Walkable, no cover.

cells.name: Moss stain
cells.description: Floor decal: an uneven stain of slime and moss with root threads. Walkable, no cover.

cells.name: Assembly line module
cells.description: A straight 6x3 section of a dead assembly line: roller bed flush to both short ends so sections join end to end (long axis east-west), a work station either side.

cells.name: Line intake
cells.description: The 3x3 end of an assembly line: a feed hopper housing, the line's bed leaving by its east edge with the module's cross-section.

cells.name: Empty product cradle
cells.description: A 3x3 floor cradle, clamps open, its product long pulled; the middle is open floor where a product stands.

cells.name: Stripped rack row
cells.description: A 6x2 pallet rack row, every bay empty.

cells.name: Rack row, a few crates
cells.description: The same 6x2 rack row with three crates left in it.

cells.name: Dock door
cells.description: A 4x2 loading dock: the armoured roll door along the north edge, set in the hall wall, and its leveler plate on the floor south of it.
